This source inventory lists declarations from `stdlib/` and `extended/`. It improves discovery; it does not complete the semantic API reference. Linked guides own runtime behavior, ownership, errors, numerical limits and target evidence. A declaration, method body or source import is not execution evidence.

The documentation scanner preserves declaration spellings and bounds, skips function bodies, and records enclosing impl/trait headers. It is not a compiler, type checker or package resolver. Support modules remain visible separately from ordinary modules. New modules default to source inventory with an explicitly unregistered guide.
